istem:
Research question: Tıbbi görüntü analizinde (segmentasyon, sınıflandırma, rapor üretimi) temel modellerin kullanımı üzerine en önemli çalışmalar, kanıtlar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2025-09-19. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first), each with its arXiv id and/or DOI. You may search the web.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):

calismalar.baslik: Foundation models for generalist medical artificial intelligence
calismalar.gerekce: This paper set out the generalist medical AI (GMAI) idea and its main open problems: validation, verification, bias and privacy.

calismalar.baslik: Segment Anything in Medical Images
calismalar.gerekce: MedSAM is a universal promptable segmentation foundation model trained on 1.5 million masks; it is the reference baseline for medical segmentation.

calismalar.baslik: A foundation model for generalizable disease detection from retinal images
calismalar.gerekce: RETFound showed that a self-supervised foundation model can classify ocular and systemic diseases with very little labelled data.

calismalar.baslik: Towards Generalist Biomedical AI
calismalar.gerekce: Med-PaLM M handles classification, report generation and question answering in one multimodal model, and clinicians evaluated its radiology reports.

calismalar.baslik: Segment Anything
calismalar.gerekce: SAM is the general-purpose promptable segmentation model that the whole line of medical SAM adaptations builds on.

calismalar.baslik: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
calismalar.gerekce: CLIP introduced the contrastive image-text pretraining approach that underlies medical vision-language foundation models.

calismalar.baslik: Expert-level detection of pathologies from unannotated chest X-ray images via self-supervised learning
calismalar.gerekce: CheXzero reached expert-level zero-shot chest X-ray classification using only image-report pairs.

calismalar.baslik: Towards a general-purpose foundation model for computational pathology
calismalar.gerekce: UNI is a self-supervised pathology foundation model trained on more than 100 million tiles and tested on 34 tasks.

calismalar.baslik: A visual-language foundation model for computational pathology
calismalar.gerekce: CONCH brought zero-shot classification, segmentation and retrieval to pathology through image-text pretraining.

calismalar.baslik: A whole-slide foundation model for digital pathology from real-world data
calismalar.gerekce: Prov-GigaPath models whole slides with real-world data at the scale of 1.3 billion tiles.

calismalar.baslik: LLaVA-Med: Training a Large Language-and-Vision Assistant for Biomedicine in One Day
calismalar.gerekce: LLaVA-Med is the foundational work showing how to tune a conversational biomedical multimodal LLM cheaply.

calismalar.baslik: BiomedCLIP: a multimodal biomedical foundation model pretrained from fifteen million scientific image-text pairs
calismalar.gerekce: BiomedCLIP is a widely used biomedical CLIP model trained on 15 million image-text pairs from PubMed Central.

calismalar.baslik: A generalist vision-language foundation model for diverse biomedical tasks
calismalar.gerekce: BiomedGPT is an open generalist model that covers classification, VQA and report generation together.

calismalar.baslik: Consensus, dissensus and synergy between clinicians and specialist foundation models in radiology report generation
calismalar.gerekce: This is a large clinician-evaluation study of foundation-model radiology reports, and it shows the gains from human-AI collaboration.

calismalar.baslik: Towards Generalist Foundation Model for Radiology by Leveraging Web-scale 2D&3D Medical Data
calismalar.gerekce: RadFM is a generalist radiology model that handles 2D and 3D data together, released with the large MedMD dataset and a benchmark.

calismalar.baslik: CheXagent: Towards a Foundation Model for Chest X-Ray Interpretation
calismalar.gerekce: CheXagent is a chest X-ray foundation model with an instruction dataset and the CheXbench evaluation benchmark.

calismalar.baslik: MAIRA-1: A specialised large multimodal model for radiology report generation
calismalar.gerekce: MAIRA-1 is a strong large multimodal model built specifically for chest X-ray report generation.

calismalar.baslik: Contrastive Learning of Medical Visual Representations from Paired Images and Text
calismalar.gerekce: ConVIRT pioneered medical image-report contrastive pretraining and was a precursor to CLIP.

calismalar.baslik: GLoRIA: A Multimodal Global-Local Representation Learning Framework for Label-efficient Medical Image Recognition
calismalar.gerekce: GLoRIA showed label-efficient recognition and segmentation through local alignment between image regions and report words.

calismalar.baslik: Making the Most of Text Semantics to Improve Biomedical Vision-Language Processing
calismalar.gerekce: BioViL showed that domain-specific text modelling improves medical vision-language performance.

calismalar.baslik: MedCLIP: Contrastive Learning from Unpaired Medical Images and Text
calismalar.gerekce: MedCLIP made data-efficient medical CLIP training possible with unpaired data and tackled the false-negative problem.

calismalar.baslik: Knowledge-enhanced visual-language pre-training on chest radiology images
calismalar.gerekce: KAD showed that adding medical knowledge graphs to pretraining improves zero-shot diagnosis.

calismalar.baslik: Segment anything model for medical images?
calismalar.gerekce: This study systematically showed SAM's limits on medical data and established the evidence for why adaptation is needed.

calismalar.baslik: Medical SAM Adapter: Adapting Segment Anything Model for Medical Image Segmentation
calismalar.gerekce: It introduced parameter-efficient adapter tuning of SAM for medical images, including 3D.

calismalar.baslik: SAM-Med2D
calismalar.gerekce: SAM-Med2D fine-tuned SAM on about 20 million medical masks for 2D medical segmentation.

calismalar.baslik: SAM-Med3D
calismalar.gerekce: SAM-Med3D is a fully 3D promptable segmentation model for volumetric medical images.

calismalar.baslik: A foundation model for joint segmentation, detection and recognition of biomedical objects across nine modalities
calismalar.gerekce: BiomedParse performs text-prompted segmentation, detection and recognition together across nine modalities.

calismalar.baslik: CLIP-Driven Universal Model for Organ Segmentation and Tumor Detection
calismalar.gerekce: It brought text embeddings into a universal CT segmentation model that learns from many partially labelled datasets.

calismalar.baslik: Foundation model for cancer imaging biomarkers
calismalar.gerekce: This work showed that a self-supervised CT foundation model gives robust performance on imaging biomarkers with limited data.

calismalar.baslik: Demographic Bias of Expert-Level Vision-Language Foundation Models in Medical Imaging
calismalar.gerekce: It documented that medical foundation models under-diagnose some demographic groups, a key open problem in fairness and safety.
